name: The Looking Glass Card
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Prop: cards
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: one creature
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

You slide an archetype card from the deck, sending The Looking Glass card spinning across the battlefield. The target takes 2d6 points of damage +1 point per caster level . If the target fails a Will save, you teleport the target 10 feet to a location of your choice within range.

If you are wielding a deck of cards, you can choose one ally within 30 feet of the target. You teleport that ally a number of feet equal to 5 times your Charisma modifier to a location of your choice within range.
